simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כּוּמָז (H3558) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כּוּמָז (kûwmâz) means a jewel (probably gold beads) First listed occurrence: Exod 35 22.

definitions.full: H3558. kumaz כּוּמָז noun [masculine] name of a golden ornament ; — וְכ וְטַבַּעַת וָנֶזֶם ׳חָח Exod 35:22 ; וְכ ׳עָגִיל טַבַּעַת וְצָמִיד אֶצְעָדָה Num 31:50 (both P).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to store away;
